recommendedAction: Take CE-LAS-3300 out of production for a laser tube power measurement and full optical path alignment within the week, and request a service-contract quote from Contoso Fabrication Systems before any parts are ordered.
rationale: Two work orders in the last 90 days against a mean interval of 78 days shows the failure cadence is accelerating, and the newest ticket (incomplete cuts on 6 mm acrylic) is a classic laser tube power-loss symptom rather than an isolated fault. Two of the four historical work orders are still open, so the underlying degradation has never been closed out. The warranty expired on 2025-08-22, so any repair is billable and should be quoted before the machine fails mid-job.
